annotation.title_clean: ISO10218-1 로봇 및 로봇장치 ─ 산업용 로봇의 안전에 관한 요구사항 ─ 제1부：로봇
annotation.title_en: KS ISO 10218-1: Robots and robotic devices — Safety requirements for industrial robots — Part 1: Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 국가기술표준원 (Korean Agency for Technology and Standards, KATS)
annotation.summary_en: Korean national standards portal page for KS ISO 10218-1, an identical adoption of ISO 10218-1:2011 on safety requirements for industrial robots. It gives metadata, scope (inherently safe design, protective measures, hazards), cited standards, related technical rules, and revision history since 2008. Full standard text is not shown.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies safety requirements and guidance for inherently safe design, protective measures and use information for industrial robots
Identical (IDT) adoption of ISO 10218-1:2011; established 2008, last revised 2021
Does not apply to non-industrial robots, though its safety principles may be applied to them
Cites ISO 13850, ISO 13849-1, IEC 60204-1, ISO 10218-2 and ISO 9283
Linked to Korean Ministry of Employment and Labor safety inspection notices
